note: European home-market pool (ESEF / IFRS), read from each issuer's own annual reports. Figures as-filed in the reporting currency; ratios are currency-neutral. operatingIncome = REPORTED operating result (not adjusted APM); capex = purchase of PP&E + intangibles (ex-acquisitions); totalDebt = gross financial debt ex put/earn-out. Pernod Ricard and Heineken are pending an enrichment round (equity total / net revenue). Depreciation to be added across the pool to enable the steady-state valuation base.
